name: Netorare Hitozuma ~Saiai no Tsuma wa, Ore no Sei de......~
original_name: 寝取られ人妻～最愛の妻は、俺のせいで……～
source:
Beloved wife, always smiling. Then before her husband's eyes, another man seduces the hell out of her!

Once an elite business man, Seiji has fallen into debt.
His wife still stood beside him, supportive as ever.

For her sake he decided to risk it all and went to a loan shark... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE080798.html]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
深爱的妻子总是面带笑容。可就在丈夫眼前，另一个男人把她彻底勾引到手！

诚司曾是一名精英商务人士，如今却负债累累。
妻子依然陪伴在他身边，一如既往地支持着他。

为了妻子，他决定赌上一切，前去找高利贷借钱……

[引自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE080798.html]DLsite[/url]]
